description: The release calendar joined to what each report last said: expected_at with a real Eastern offset, the last print's values, week-on-week change, the 5-year comparison, and a surprise label. Use this instead of calendar.get when you need the numbers as well as the timing — calendar.get answers only *when*. `last` is null when nothing is stored yet and surprise_label is null when no 5-year band exists; neither is ever guessed. Paid.

release_id.description: One release id, as published by calendar.get

window_days.description: Keep only releases expected within this many days. Releases with no known date are excluded by a window.

name: releases.next

expected_at.description: Full timestamp with Eastern offset, or null when no clock time is published for this release

expected_date.description: ISO date of the next expected release

last.description: The last stored print, or null when nothing is stored for this release

title: Next Releases With Last Print
